worldcombat.skill.ironhead.summary: Sinks a steel-hard head and slams it home in one short step: the shortest reach and slowest start of the family, but a hit hurls the target away and staggers it the longest. It runs on Defence and weight, and is built to clear space up close.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.description.0: The headbutt deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block collision radius; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.description.1: It steps %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick and hurls the target %3$s blocks on a hit.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.description.2: A hit adds %1$s blocks per tick of lift; flinch chance %2$s for %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.braced.on: Braced form: a shorter step, but heavier - staggers longer, hurls farther, with a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.braced.off: Quick form: a longer step and a faster cast, with slightly less power and knockback.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.growth.0: From level %1$s the headbutt power rises to %2$s and the hurl distance to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.growth.1: From level %1$s the headbutt power rises to %2$s, the step to %3$s blocks, the hurl to %4$s blocks and the flinch chance to %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.use.0: Clear the space around you when crowded
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.use.1: Hurl a target off a ledge or out of a position
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.use.2: Lock a target down with the longest stagger
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.preference.br: On: a shorter step, but heavier - staggers longer, hurls farther, with a longer wind-up and cooldown. Off: quick form, a longer step and a faster cast, with slightly less power and knockback.
worldcombat.skill.ironhead.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The reach is tiny, so a larger value still often cannot connect.
Close: only use it once a target is within about 2.2 blocks, purely to hurl them off. Always: treat it as an ordinary heavy hit, connecting whenever in reach.
